Name: Miku Mod Plus
Author: tikamin557
Description:
The original mod is "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4373]CP_Miku NPC[/url]﻿" created by "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/65946901]ChaseXavier[/url]".
"ChaseXavier" allows mod edit/continue, so I created this mod.

Many items about Miku were copied from its original mod.

[color=#00ffff][size=4]Items that have been changed, modified, or added.[/size][/color]
･[color=#00ff00]Built-in HD portraits.[/color]
Built-in portraits displayed using “[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]”.
If you do not see it, press the “P” key (default) several times when the dialog window is displayed.
･[color=#00ff00]Miku's house relations.[/color]
Miku's house is largely new.
Miku's house can be accessed from a computer that will be added to the saloon.
(If another mod is editing the saloon and the computer is not visible, please let us know on the POSTS page).
･[color=#00ff00]Additional spouse room.[/color]
Newly added. You can access Miku's house from the computer in your spouse's room.
(If you get married, the computer in the saloon will be removed.)
･[color=#00ff00]Schedule Changes.[/color]
The schedule has been revised, starting at Miku's house, visiting different places depending on the day of the week, and spending the evening at the saloon.
Exclusive conversations appear when Miku is in some locations.
･[color=#00ff00]Participation in festivals.[/color]
Miku will participate in festivals; festival variations (even years) added in SDV1.6 are also supported.
･[color=#00ff00]Additional dialogs.[/color]
Conversations that occur under some conditions have been added.
Other minor corrections and additions.
･[color=#00ff00]Visit Ginger Island.[/color]

[color=#00ffff][size=4]To be added through updates.[/size][/color]
  Additional Conversations.
  Addition of schedule.
  Addition and modification of heart events.
...etc.  I will add more as I think of them.


Two event scenes currently exist.
The conditions for their occurrence are as follows[spoiler]
[list]
[*]10 Heart Event A (Cindersap Forest)
[/list]Miku friendship level is over 2500 (10 Heart). 
Time is between 9:00 and 17:00.
The weather is sunny.
Not married to Miku.
[list]
[*]10 Heart Event B (Farm)
[/list]Miku friendship level is over 2500 (10 Heart). 
Time is between 19:00 and 22:00.
The weather is sunny.
Not married to Miku.
Have already watched "10 Heart Event A" by Miku.[/spoiler]


[color=#ffff00][size=3]About "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16507]FarmhouseFixes[/url]" mod.[/size][/color]
Activate the “[color=#00ff00]Un-Hardcoded\nFarmhouse/Cabin Warps[/color]” setting in the "Farmhouse Fixes".
When you marry Miku and use the warp in the spouse room if it warps to a strange position, follow the ModConfig settings for this mod.[spoiler]After marrying Miku, warping from the PC in Miku's house will usually take you back to the spouse's room. If you are using another mod that changes the location of the spousal room, it may warp to a strange position. In this case, disable the "Un-Hardcoded Farmhouse/Cabin Warps" in the "FarmhouseFixes" mod. Warp changes to farmhouse entrance. If you do not want to disable it due to circumstances with other mods, please enable the following settings.
･Make warp a BusStop
Enabling this setting changes the PC warp of Miku's house to a bus stop when she is married to Miku.[/spoiler]
If you have any questions or mod problems, please go to the POSTS page.

Currently, English (default) and Japanese translation files are included.
(For users submitting translation mods.
In that case, please submit only i18n files. Do not edit “content.json” or the json in the “assets” folder directly.
Some parts of these json are written in Japanese, which I wrote for ease of checking when creating the mod, and will not be displayed when the mod is used.)

Translation mods for other languages are here.
